# IR kind: resourcelir

[@0] %T5: sram = scratchpad
[@1] raw.page_table_update vp0->pp0, vp1->pp1, vp2->pp2, vp3->pp3, vp4->pp4, vp5->pp5, vp6->pp6, vp7->pp7
[@2] %T3: sram = dma.dto_s %T1
[@3] raw.page_table_update vp8->pp8, vp9->pp9
[@4] %T4: sram = dma.dto_s %T0
[@5] %T17: sram = for %T7 in 0..8 {
    init_state %T5 -> %T6
    [@5.0] %T8: spm = core_imp_cmd %T7
    [@5.1] raw.wait main_context
    [@5.2] raw.wait sub_context
    [@5.3] raw.load_sfr lir(@3.6)
    [@5.4] raw.wait dma(1), source=lir(@2)
    [@5.5] %T9: sram = index_access %T4, %T8
    [@5.6] raw.profile 16, trace
    [@5.7] %T10: trf = rngd_cmd.sto_trf %T9
    [@5.8] %T12: spm = core_imp_cmd %T7
    [@5.9] raw.wait dma(0), source=lir(@3.7)
    [@5.10] %T13: sram = index_access %T6, %T12
    [@5.11] %T16: spm = core_imp_cmd %T7
    [@5.12] raw.wait sub_context, source=lir(@3.2)
    [@5.13] raw.profile 17, trace
    [@5.14] raw.wait dma(0), source=lir(@1)
    [@5.15] raw.profile 26, trace
    [@5.16] %T11: sram = rngd_cmd.tu_exec %T3, %T10
    [@5.17] raw.wait main_context, source=lir(@3.6)
    [@5.18] raw.profile 27, trace
    [@5.19] %T14: sram = dma.sto_s %T11, %T13
    [@5.20] %T15: sram = index_write %T6, %T16, %T14
    yield %T15
}
[@6] raw.wait main_context
[@7] raw.wait sub_context
[@8] raw.load_sfr lir(@4)
[@9] raw.wait dma(0), source=lir(@3.7)
[@10] raw.profile 34, trace
[@11] %T18: sram = rngd_cmd.tu_exec %T17
[@12] raw.wait main_context, source=lir(@4)
[@13] raw.profile 35, trace
[@14] %T20: dram = dma.sto_d %T18, %T2
[@15] raw.wait dma(0), source=lir(@5)
[@16] raw.profile 42, trace
[@17] raw.sync_release cluster, timestamp=1, from=explicit_sync(lir(@6))
[@18] %T19: dram = cluster_sync %T20
[@19] raw.sync_acquire cluster, timestamp=1, from=explicit_sync(lir(@6))
[@20] raw.profile 43, trace
[@21] raw.update_base_timestamp 1
